bronze.name: VBAK
bronze.description: Sales Document Header Data – Contains commercial header information for sales orders, contracts, quotations and scheduling agreements including sold-to party, document type, net value, sales area and requested delivery date

MANDT.description: SAP Client – Logical partition (mandant) within the SAP S4H system

VBELN.description: Sales Document Number – Unique identifier for the sales order in SAP S4H

ERDAT.description: Creation Date – Date when the sales order was created in the system

ERNAM.description: Created By – User who created the sales order

ANGDT.description: Quotation Valid From – Start date of the validity period for quotations

BNDDT.description: Quotation Valid To – End date of the validity period for quotations

AUDAT.description: Document Date – Date of the sales document as stated by the customer

AUART.description: Sales Document Type – Categorizes the sales document (e.g., OR=Standard Order, RE=Returns, KA=Consignment)

AUGRU.description: Order Reason – Reason code for the order (e.g., replacement, planned purchase, campaign)

GWLDT.description: Warranty Start Date – Date from which the warranty period begins for the sold product

LIFSK.description: Delivery Block – Block indicator preventing delivery creation from this order

FAKSK.description: Billing Block – Block indicator preventing billing document creation from this order

NETWR.description: Net Value – Total net value of the sales order in document currency (after discounts, before tax)

WAERK.description: Document Currency – Currency key for all amounts in the sales order

VKORG.description: Sales Organization – Organizational unit responsible for selling the products

VTWEG.description: Distribution Channel – Channel through which the products reach the customer (e.g., wholesale, retail)

SPART.description: Division – Product line or business segment (e.g., motorcycles, marine, power equipment)

VKGRP.description: Sales Group – Group of sales personnel responsible for processing the order

VKBUR.description: Sales Office – Physical or virtual office responsible for the sales territory

KNUMV.description: Document Condition Number – Reference to the pricing condition records applied to this order

VDATU.description: Requested Delivery Date – Date the customer has requested for goods delivery

AUTLF.description: Complete Delivery Indicator – Flag indicating if the order must be delivered in a single shipment

KALSM.description: Pricing Procedure – Determines the sequence of condition types (discounts, surcharges, taxes) applied

VSBED.description: Shipping Conditions – Defines the shipping method agreed with the customer (e.g., standard, express)

FKARA.description: Order-Related Billing Type – Billing document type to be used for order-related billing

AWAHR.description: Order Probability – Percentage probability of the order being confirmed (used in quotations/inquiries)

KTEXT.description: Description – Free-text description of the sales order header

BSTNK.description: Customer Purchase Order Number – The customer's own PO number referenced in the sales order

BSARK.description: Customer Purchase Order Type – Type classification of the customer's purchase order

BSTDK.description: Customer Purchase Order Date – Date of the customer's purchase order

IHREZ.description: Your Reference – Customer's external reference text for correspondence and tracking

KUNNR.description: Sold-to Party – Customer number of the party who ordered the goods or services

KOSTL.description: Cost Center – Cost center for internal cost allocation of the sales order

AEDAT.description: Last Changed On – Date of the most recent change to the sales order

KVGR1.description: Customer Group 1 – First customer classification attribute for reporting and pricing conditions

KVGR2.description: Customer Group 2 – Second customer classification attribute for reporting and pricing conditions

KVGR3.description: Customer Group 3 – Third customer classification attribute for reporting and pricing conditions

KVGR4.description: Customer Group 4 – Fourth customer classification attribute for reporting and pricing conditions

KVGR5.description: Customer Group 5 – Fifth customer classification attribute for reporting and pricing conditions

KNUMA.description: Sales Deal / Agreement Number – Reference to a sales deal or master agreement for special pricing

KKBER.description: Credit Control Area – Organizational unit responsible for monitoring and managing customer credit limits

KNKLI.description: Credit Account Number – Customer's credit management account used for credit exposure tracking

GRUPP.description: Customer Credit Group – Groups customers for differentiated credit checking rules

CMFRE.description: Credit Release Date – Date the order was released from credit hold

AMTBL.description: Released Credit Value – Credit value amount released for this sales order

HITYP_PR.description: Hierarchy Type for Pricing – Customer hierarchy type used for pricing determination

ABRVW.description: Usage Indicator – Usage indicator for delivery scheduling and availability check

ABDIS.description: MRP for Delivery Schedule Type – MRP relevance indicator for scheduling agreements

BUKRS_VF.description: Company Code for Billing – Company code to which billing revenues are posted

FMBDAT.description: Material Availability Date – Date from which materials must be available for the order

CONT_DG.description: Contains Dangerous Goods – Indicator that the order contains hazardous materials

bronze.name: VBAP
bronze.description: Sales Document Item Data – Line-item details for sales documents including material, quantity, pricing, plant, weight, volume, rejection reason and profit center

MANDT.description: SAP Client – Logical partition (mandant) within the SAP S4H system

POSNR.description: Sales Document Item Number – Line item number within the sales order

MATNR.description: Material Number – SAP material master number identifying the product being sold

PMATN.description: Pricing Reference Material – Material number used as reference for pricing determination

CHARG.description: Batch Number – Batch/lot number for batch-managed materials

MATKL.description: Material Group – Classification of the material into a procurement/reporting group

ARKTX.description: Item Description – Short text description of the material at the line item level

POSAR.description: Item Type – Categorization of the item (e.g., standard, text, value item)

ABGRU.description: Rejection Reason – Reason code for rejecting a sales document item (e.g., price too high, competitor won)

PRODH.description: Product Hierarchy – Multi-level product classification for reporting and condition records

ZIEME.description: Target Quantity Unit of Measure – Unit of measure for the target quantity in contracts

NETWR.description: Net Value in Document Currency – Net value of the line item after all pricing conditions

KWMENG.description: Order Quantity – Cumulative confirmed order quantity in sales unit

VRKME.description: Sales Unit of Measure – Unit in which the material is sold to the customer

NTGEW.description: Net Weight – Weight of the line item excluding packaging

VOLUM.description: Volume – Total volume of the line item

WERKS.description: Delivering Plant – Plant from which the material will be shipped to the customer

ROUTE.description: Shipping Route – Transportation route for delivery from the plant to the customer

NETPR.description: Net Price – Price per unit after all discounts and surcharges

SHKZG.description: Returns Item Indicator – Flag identifying this item as a return (credit) item

WAVWR.description: Cost in Document Currency – Statistical cost value of the item for profitability analysis

PRCTR.description: Profit Center – Organizational unit for internal profit reporting and management

PAOBJNR.description: Profitability Segment Number – CO-PA profitability segment assigned to the item

AUFNR.description: Internal Order Number – CO internal order for cost allocation of the line item

bronze.name: VBFA
bronze.description: Sales Document Flow – Tracks the complete lifecycle chain between related documents (order → delivery → billing → accounting) with predecessor/successor links and quantities

MANDT.description: SAP Client – Logical partition (mandant) within the SAP S4H system

VBELV.description: Preceding Document Number – Document number of the predecessor in the document flow chain

POSNV.description: Preceding Item Number – Item number in the preceding document

VBELN.description: Subsequent Document Number – Document number of the successor in the document flow chain

POSNN.description: Subsequent Item Number – Item number in the subsequent document

VBTYP_N.description: Subsequent Document Category – Category code of the subsequent document (C=Order, J=Delivery, M=Invoice)

RFMNG.description: Reference Quantity – Quantity transferred between predecessor and successor documents

RFWRT.description: Reference Value – Monetary value transferred between predecessor and successor documents

VBTYP_V.description: Preceding Document Category – Category code of the preceding document

ERDAT.description: Creation Date – Date when the document flow record was created

BWART.description: Movement Type – Inventory movement type associated with the document flow (e.g., 601=Goods Issue for Delivery)

WBSTA.description: Goods Movement Status – Status of the goods movement associated with the document flow entry

bronze.name: VBKD
bronze.description: Sales Document Business Data – Payment terms, incoterms, pricing date, billing date, exchange rates, customer references and additional commercial conditions at header and item level

MANDT.description: SAP Client – Logical partition (mandant) within the SAP S4H system

KONDA.description: Price Group – Customer price group for condition record access in pricing

KDGRP.description: Customer Group – Customer classification group for pricing and statistics

PLTYP.description: Price List Type – Price list category for condition record access

INCO1.description: Incoterms Part 1 – International commercial terms code (e.g., FOB, CIF, EXW)

KURRF.description: Exchange Rate for Pricing – Exchange rate used for pricing calculations

KTGRD.description: Account Assignment Group for Customer – Controls G/L account determination for revenue posting

PRSDT.description: Pricing Date – Date used to determine valid condition records for pricing

FKDAT.description: Billing Date – Planned date for billing document creation

GJAHR.description: Fiscal Year – Fiscal year for accounting assignments

BSTKD.description: Customer Reference Number – Customer's own reference number for the order item

VSART.description: Shipping Type – Mode of transport for the shipment (e.g., road, rail, sea, air)

PODKZ.description: POD Relevant Indicator – Flag indicating the item requires Proof of Delivery confirmation

bronze.name: VBPA
bronze.description: Sales Document Partner Functions – Partner assignments (sold-to, ship-to, bill-to, payer, sales employee) for sales documents at header and item level

MANDT.description: SAP Client – Logical partition (mandant) within the SAP S4H system

PARVW.description: Partner Function – Role of the partner in the sales process (AG=Sold-to, WE=Ship-to, RE=Bill-to, RG=Payer)

KUNNR.description: Customer Number – SAP customer master number of the assigned partner

LIFNR.description: Supplier Number – SAP vendor master number (for forwarding agents or external partners)

ABLAD.description: Unloading Point – Specific location at the ship-to address for goods unloading

LAND1.description: Country/Region – Country key of the partner's address

STCEG.description: VAT Registration Number – Value Added Tax registration number of the partner

silver.name: sales_order
silver.description: Sales Order – Core transactional document in SAP S4H Sales & Distribution (SD) representing a customer's request to purchase goods or services. Contains header-level commercial terms (VBAK), line-item details with materials, quantities and pricing (VBAP), document flow for delivery/billing traceability (VBFA), business data such as payment terms and incoterms (VBKD), and partner functions like sold-to, ship-to and bill-to parties (VBPA). Key document in the Order-to-Cash (OTC) process.

silver.name: inv_mov_stock
silver.description: Inventory Movements & Stock – Transactional and master data in SAP S4H for tracking material movements and stock levels. Includes material document headers with posting dates and transaction types (MKPF), material document line items with movement types, quantities and values (MSEG), plant-level material master data with MRP and procurement parameters (MARC), and storage-location-level stock quantities (MARD). Core to the Inventory Management (MM-IM) subprocess within Plan-to-Fulfill.
